evidenceBoundary: The built Webhooks single-file app runs in a real sandboxed ExtensionHost with manifest-derived webhooks:crud and ui:toast grants. HostServices callbacks are deterministic local fixtures that record exact RPC inputs, enforce Core's 16–512 character custom-secret validation, and persist the simulated Core secret in session storage across reload. Clipboard access is exercised in Chromium with explicit test-context permission. This does not prove a live Core node, an external webhook sender, or a real ingress backend.
